global: A steaming bowl of shoyu ramen glows with rich, amber broth. Topped with tender chashu and crisp menma, it’s garnished with finely sliced green onions, all nestled in a pristine white bowl against a dark, softly lit background.

regions.background: Dark marbled table surface with swirling gray and black patterns, smooth and reflective under ambient light.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, rounded rim.
regions.soup: The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is golden-brown, glossy, and clear, with thin noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
regions.meat: The chashu pork is a round, tender slice with a glistening surface, showing a pinkish-white interior and a slightly browned edge.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with a curved, elongated shape and visible fibrous texture.
